caption: The drawing features a single rectangular chest with a flat top and a single drawer at its base. The chest's surfaces are colored primarily in shades of green, with distinctive, swirling dark green and black lines simulating the appearance of wood grain. These faux wood grain patterns are present on the front, side, and drawer, adding a sense of texture. The top surface is lighter in color, primarily brownish-tan, giving a wooden look. The chest stands on short, bracket-like feet and the visible front drawer includes two round, brown knobs. The background of the image is a plain beige or off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Painted Wooden Chest
